description: This file defines the ModuleDao class within the OrangeHRM project, responsible for managing module entries in the database. It includes methods for retrieving module lists, updating module statuses, fetching disabled/enabled modules, and managing data group permissions related to modules. The class interacts with the database via Doctrine ORM and dispatches events on status changes.

classes.name: ModuleDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object class for managing HRM modules, including retrieval and status update functionalities within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getModuleList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all Module entities from the database.

methods.name: updateModuleStatus
methods.description: Updates the status (enabled/disabled) of modules based on the provided associative array of module names and statuses, and dispatches status change events.

methods.name: getDisabledModuleList
methods.description: Returns a list of names of modules that are currently disabled.

methods.name: getEnabledModuleNameList
methods.description: Returns a list of names of modules that are currently enabled.

methods.name: updateDataGroupPermissionForWidgetModules
methods.description: Sets read permissions for data groups related to widget modules based on the provided data group name and status.

methods.name: getDataGroupByDataGroupName
methods.description: Retrieves a DataGroup entity by its name.

methods.name: getUserRolePermissionsByDataGroupId
methods.description: Fetches user role permission entries associated with a specific data group ID.
